title: Steadier dice rolls and lighter room checks
summary: Character rolls no longer fail when someone chats at the same moment, and shared campaigns do less work on every update.
items: If another action lands while a roll is being saved, the roll is prepared again from the new state instead of asking you to reload (up to three tries; the same roll is never saved twice).
Checking whether a campaign has an active encounter now uses an index, instead of looking through every encounter on the site on each update.
Saving a shared campaign no longer re-sends the whole campaign once per signed-in player.
